script: if ($ExecutionContext.SessionState.LanguageMode -eq 'FullLanguage') { $OutputEncoding = [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false) }; Import-Module -Name 'Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility', 'Microsoft.PowerShell.Security' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"; $signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $env:XINGMANG_NATIVE_CLI; $xingmangJson = @{ Status = [string]$signature.Status; Subject = [string]$signature.SignerCertificate.Subject; Issuer = [string]$signature.SignerCertificate.Issuer } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; if ($ExecutionContext.SessionState.LanguageMode -ne 'FullLanguage' -and $xingmangJson -match '[^\x00-\x7F]') { $xingmangJson = -join @(foreach ($xingmangChar in $xingmangJson.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$xingmangChar -gt 127) { '\u{0:x4}' -f [int]$xingmangChar } else { [string]$xingmangChar } }) }; $xingmangJson
